resolution_rule: World/entity truth resolves first; this index only selects presentation profiles and cannot invent identity, capability, affiliation or current state.
rules: Species profile never chooses personality, culture, organization or clothing.
Era/operator profiles never change console functionality.
Planet profiles never invent unknown physical geography.
NAP output must preserve entity/visual identity lineage and profile versions.
Facility visuals cannot create unsupported services, modules, docking capacity or operator history.
Procedural civilization/species visuals must reuse persistent generated morphology, culture, technology and individual visual identities.
